notes: The adapter supplies a local FOM file and additional module. The pure standard-API scenario constructs a percent-escaped local file URL, creates the federation from that URL, and verifies that the federation MOM reports the exact supplied designator before and after an additional-module join. The pinned Lab candidate has broad clause-4 provenance. HTTP/remote fetching, every URL authority/escape form, Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
